edits.proposed_raw:
<Tip>

Memory aid: spread, mat, deep, settle. Spread foundations need adequate near-surface support; mats merge and distribute loads to reduce differential settlement; piles or caissons are evaluated when shallow bearing is inadequate; serviceability settlement can still govern.

</Tip>
